svg.title: ConcurrentHashMap (Java 8+) CAS, Bin-Level Locking and Volatile Reads
svg.desc: Animated diagram showing Thread A inserting into empty Bucket[1] via lock-free CAS, Thread B and Thread C contending only on fine-grained synchronized(head) of Bucket[3], and Thread D reading Bucket[5] concurrently via volatile get().
svg.text: ConcurrentHashMap (Java 8+) — CAS, Bin Lock & Volatile Reads
B mutates Bin[3]; C waits (Bins 1, 5 FREE)
B released -> C wakes & appends k4 ✔
